title: A1 has no test that observes a live run three ways; add the run-level observer regression test
body: A1 requires a test that fetches, lists findings and reads the branch mid-run. The only test, TestAnOperatorFetchingInTheRunsCheckoutEndsNothing, runs git fetch against a bare Store with no reconciler, which is why the findings race above shipped green. The repro in runs/epic-9pd/h0f/repro/reconcile_observer_test.go.txt is the shape of that test.
